newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch call extra talks on EU reform process.
newsitem.headline: Dutch call extra talks on EU reform process.

text.p: The Dutch European Union presidency on Saturday called an extra meeting of foreign ministers in April in an attempt to step up the bloc's treaty reform negotiations.
The Netherlands has pledged to see the inter-governmental conference (IGC) through to a meaningful conclusion at a mid-June summit in Amsterdam.

Dutch Foreign Minister Hans van Mierlo set the extra session to try and force the pace in the reform process, his spokesman said, adding that no date had yet been fixed and the meeting could be held in the Netherlands or in Belgium.
The IGC aims to review the workings of the 15-member bloc to prepare it for its planned expansion to up to two dozen nations.

The tortuous negotiations aim to streamline the EU's unwieldy institutions, reforming the decision-making voting procedures and reviewing how many seats each member may have in the executive EC Commission.
